verdict.rationale: Nitrokey documents how fixes reach devices: a dedicated Nitrokey 3 firmware-update guide, tagged installable firmware releases on GitHub (v1.8.3), firmware updates listed as a product feature, and dated per-version release notes for NetHSM. The pack has no security advisories, no affected-model lookup, and no stated vulnerability-response process. missing for 10: published security advisories, affected-model/version lookup, documented vulnerability disclosure and response process, independent corroboration of update delivery.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor has a clear firmware update and vulnerability-response story — advisories, affected-model lookup, and how fixes reach devices

citations.quote: Nitrokey 3 firmware is open source in Rust WITH tagged, installable releases
the official Nitrokey/nethsm repository publishes dated release notes per firmware version
